# GCSL split ledger

This ledger freezes the two current-study evaluation sets selected before any
GCSL policy outcome existed. Candidate scanning was ascending and deterministic.
Every accepted task is route- and full-task-disjoint from all 2,595 reachable
canonical training rows and all legitimately opened historical evaluation
content. The two sets are internally unique and mutually disjoint on numeric
seed, route hash, and full-task hash.

Training therefore uses fixed canonical training streams with disclosed
historical-content overlap, while current-study train/evaluation separation is
verified exhaustively below.
